title: Awesome-design-md: a collection of Markdown files capturing the design systems of 55+ tech companies
description:
Claude Code builds functional UIs that all look like they came from the same generic template. Awesome-design-md is a collection of plain-text Markdown files capturing the exact design systems of 55+ top tech companies. Stripe, Vercel, Linear, Notion, Apple. Drop the DESIGN.md for the aesthetic you want into your project root and your agent builds with their exact typography, hex codes, spacing, and component states.

https://github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-design-md

#github #opensource
